common.agency: Plateau State Agency for the Control of AIDS
common.privacyFooter: We collect counts only. This platform never stores beneficiary names, addresses or HIV test results.
common.countsOnlyBody: This platform stores aggregate numbers per indicator. It never asks for a beneficiary name, address, phone number or HIV test result.

auth.signInIntro: Use the email address or phone number PLACA gave you.
auth.passwordHint: Type the password you chose. It is not shown on screen.
auth.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for PLACA.
auth.setupIntro: Your role protects sensitive data, so a second step is required. Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Authy.
auth.setupSecretLabel: Or type this secret into the app
auth.setupCodeLabel: Type the 6-digit code shown in the app
auth.setupRestart: This setup session has ended. Sign in again to restart.
auth.changeIntro: You are using a temporary password. Choose your own before continuing.
auth.passwordRules: Use at least 8 characters, with a capital letter, a small letter and a number.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.acceptIntro: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email address or phone number. If the account has an email address, we will send a reset link.
auth.resetIntro: Pick a password you have not used before.
auth.verifyIntro: Press the button to confirm this email address.
auth.temporaryNote: Temporary passwords are read aloud. Never share yours after you change it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.statusIntro: Your account is ready. Use the modules below for the work your role allows.
dashboard.readyRoles: Role-based access for PLACA, LACA and partners
dashboard.readyAudit: An audit trail that cannot be edited
dashboard.readyProgramme: Organization approval, workplans and report intake
dashboard.modulesIntro: Open the part of the platform you need. You only see organizations and records your role is allowed to use.
dashboard.orgsCard: Register partners and keep their approval status current.
dashboard.orgsCardPartner: Keep your organization's contact details up to date.
dashboard.workplansCard: Set quarterly targets by indicator and LGA.
dashboard.reportsCard: Enter period counts, submit them and follow validation.
dashboard.helpNote: Need help? Contact your LACA officer or the PLACA office.
dashboard.resultsIntro: Published counts from validated reports. Small numbers are withheld at LGA level so no person can be identified.
dashboard.noResultsHint: Validated reports appear here after a PLACA officer publishes them. Start with Reports to send your counts.
dashboard.statWaitingHint: Submitted by partners and not yet reviewed.
dashboard.statCoveredHint: At least one validated report in this period.
dashboard.statLocalHint: Figures published for your area in this period.
dashboard.barIntro: State total for each indicator in the chosen period.
dashboard.trendIntro: State totals for the last published periods.
dashboard.noPublished: No published figures for this period yet.
dashboard.reportedNote: These are counts reported by partners and validated by PLACA. They are not independent verification of every activity.
dashboard.coverageIntro: LGAs with at least one validated report this period.
dashboard.coverageComplete: Every LGA has at least one validated report for this period.
dashboard.lgaIntro: Small numbers below the privacy threshold are not shown.
dashboard.localIntro: Published figures for your LGA. Small numbers are withheld.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.intro: Register implementing partners and keep their approval status current. A partner cannot plan work or report until the organization is approved.
organizations.name: Organization name
organizations.focusHint: Separate each focus area with a comma, for example testing, referral.
organizations.pendingNote: New organizations start as pending. A PLACA officer approves them before their staff can report.
organizations.created: The organization was registered and is waiting for approval.
organizations.empty: No organizations match these filters yet.
organizations.approved: {{name}} can now plan work and report.
organizations.suspended: {{name}} has been suspended and can no longer submit work.
organizations.confirmSuspend: Suspend {{name}}? Its staff will not be able to submit workplans or reports until it is approved again.

workplans.title: Workplans
workplans.intro: Plan quarterly targets by indicator and LGA. Submit the plan for PLACA review; an approved plan stays fixed so reports can be compared with it.
workplans.empty: No workplans have been created for these filters yet.
workplans.emptyPartnerHint: Start a workplan to set targets for the coming quarter.
workplans.targetsHint: Add one line for each indicator and LGA. Enter the number of people or items you plan to reach this quarter.
workplans.targetRequired: Add at least one complete target before saving.
workplans.reviewHint: Check that the targets are complete and realistic. If something must change, explain it clearly before returning the plan.
workplans.returnPlaceholder: For example: add a target for people reached in Barkin Ladi.
workplans.submitted: The workplan was submitted for review.
workplans.returned: The workplan was returned to the partner with your note.
workplans.confirmDelete: Delete this draft workplan? This cannot be undone.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Enter the counts for one period. Numbers are checked for consistency before they are submitted. Only counts are stored, never names or test results.
reports.empty: No reports match these filters yet.
reports.emptyPartnerHint: Start a report to send your counts to PLACA.
reports.countsHint: Work down the form in the same order as the paper tally: the total first, then female and male, then the age groups. Leave a box empty if your organization did not do that activity.
reports.breakdownPreserved: Breakdown numbers already saved for this report are kept when you change the totals.
reports.reviewHint: Check the counts against the partner's paper form. If something does not match, explain it before returning the report.
reports.returnPlaceholder: For example: the male and female totals do not match the paper tally.
reports.noCounts: No counts have been entered yet.
reports.submitted: The report was submitted for validation.
reports.returned: The report was returned to the partner with your reason.
reports.confirmDelete: Delete this draft report? This cannot be undone.
reports.issuesIntro: {{count}} problems need attention before this report can be saved or submitted.
reports.issueNeedTotal: Enter the total first, then the breakdown.
reports.issueSexSum: Female and male add up to {{sum}}, but the total is {{total}}.
reports.issueAgeSum: The age groups add up to {{sum}}, but the total is {{total}}.
reports.privacyNote: Enter counts only. Never write a person's name, address, phone number or HIV test result on this form.
reports.exportCsvHint: Exports the reports that match these filters, one row per figure. Counts only.
reports.exportHint: Exports the reports that match these filters. Counts only.

auditLogs.title: Audit log
auditLogs.intro: Every create, update, delete, sign-in and review is recorded here. Use it to see who changed what, when and from which address.
auditLogs.readOnlyBody: This page is read-only. The database itself rejects changes to these rows, so no account can rewrite the record.
auditLogs.actionHint: Leave empty to see every action.
auditLogs.entityHint: Leave empty to see every record type.
auditLogs.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

offline.savedHere: Your work is saved on this device.
offline.allSent: Everything waiting on this device has been sent.
offline.someFailed: {{count}} item could not be sent. Check it on the Reports page.
offline.someFailed_one: {{count}} item could not be sent. Check it on the Reports page.
offline.someFailed_other: {{count}} items could not be sent. Check them on the Reports page.
offline.stillOffline: Still no signal. Your work is safe on this device.
offline.showingSaved: You are seeing saved information from this device. It will refresh when signal returns.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Messages about reviews, support requests, funding and other work that needs your attention.
notifications.allRead: All notifications are marked as read.

help.title: Help library
help.intro: Short guides for each part of the platform, written for field work and available offline once opened.
help.hintsIntro: These short notes appear beside the form fields they explain.
help.empty: No guide matches your search yet.
help.offlineNote: Guides you open are kept on this device, so you can read them again without signal.

guideEditor.title: Guide editor
guideEditor.intro: Write and update the help people see in the app. Changes reach the field without a new release.
guideEditor.confirmDelete: Delete the guide “{{title}}”? This cannot be undone.
guideEditor.keyHint: A short unique name, for example report.field.persons_tested.
guideEditor.pageKeyHint: Optional. The page this guide belongs to, for example report.
guideEditor.fieldKeyHint: Optional. Makes this a hint beside a form field.
guideEditor.audienceHint: Leave every box empty to show the guide to all signed-in users.
guideEditor.bodyHint: Use ## for headings, - for bullet lists and **bold** for emphasis.
guideEditor.emptyPreview: The preview appears here as you type.
guideEditor.empty: No guides have been written yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Guidelines, training material, workplans and policies shared with partners.
documents.fileHint: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, text, CSV or a picture. Up to 20 MB.
documents.empty: No documents match these filters yet.
documents.offlineNote: A document downloads when you open it. Keep the file on your device if you will need it in the field.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.intro: Items PLACA can supply to partners, and the stock held at state and LGA level.
equipment.name: Item name
equipment.empty: No equipment items have been added yet.
equipment.noStock: No stock has been recorded for this item yet.

support.title: Support requests
support.intro: Ask PLACA for equipment, training or technical help. Each request is tracked until it is delivered and closed.
support.descriptionHint: Explain the work and the quantity. Do not write a person's name, address or HIV test result.
support.itemsHint: Add one line for each item and the quantity you need.
support.created: The request was sent to PLACA.
support.queued: No signal. The request is saved on this device and will send when signal returns.
support.offlineHint: You can send this request with no signal. It is kept on this device until it reaches PLACA.
support.empty: No support requests match these filters yet.
support.notePlaceholder: Explain the decision or what will be supplied.
support.privacyNote: Support requests hold counts and item quantities only. Never write a person's name, address, phone number or HIV test result.

programmes.title: Programmes
programmes.intro: Plan welfare and campaign work by LGA and partner. Reports can link their counts to a programme.
programmes.name: Programme name
programmes.descriptionHint: Describe the activity. Counts are recorded separately in reports.
programmes.organizationHint: Leave empty for an LGA-wide programme.
programmes.lgaFixed: This programme will be placed in {{lga}}.
programmes.empty: No programmes match these filters yet.
programmes.privacyNote: Programmes hold activity details only. Participant names, addresses and HIV test results are never stored.

funding.title: Funding
funding.intro: Record where money comes from and how it is allocated. PLACA officers manage records; partners and LACA officers see what is allocated to them.
funding.emptySummary: No allocations have been recorded for this period.
funding.recipientHint: Choose an organization, or leave empty to allocate to the whole LGA.
funding.confirmDeleteAllocation: Delete this allocation? This cannot be undone.
funding.emptyAllocations: No allocations match these filters yet.
funding.emptySources: No funding sources have been recorded yet.
funding.confirmDeleteInflow: Delete this inflow? This cannot be undone.
funding.emptyInflows: No funding inflows have been recorded yet.
funding.privacyNote: Funding records hold amounts and purposes only. Never write a person's name, address or HIV test result.

reports.deviceIntro: Drafts and waiting work on this phone. Nothing is lost when signal drops.
reports.practiceIntro: Try the form without sending anything to PLACA. Nothing you enter here is saved to the server.
reports.practiceStarted: Practice mode is on. Nothing will be sent to PLACA.
reports.practiceSaved: Practice saved on this device. Nothing was sent to PLACA.
reports.draftRestoredBody: This device had a report draft saved before signal was lost. Check the counts, then save or submit.
reports.offlineNotice: No signal. Your work is saved on this device and can be sent when signal returns.
reports.savedOnDevice: Saved on this device. It will send when signal returns.
reports.queuedCreate: No signal. This report is saved on this device and will be created when signal returns.
reports.queuedUpdate: No signal. Your changes are saved on this device and will send when signal returns.
reports.queuedSubmit: No signal. This report is saved on this device and will be submitted when signal returns.

users.title: User management
users.intro: Manage user accounts and invite partner staff to report on the platform.
users.name: Full name
users.inviteNote: The staff member will receive an email invitation link valid for 24 hours to set their password. The account will be linked to the chosen organization.
users.successSent: Partner staff account for {{name}} was created and an invitation email was sent to {{email}}.
users.successSandboxed: Partner staff account for {{name}} was created. In development mode, email delivery was sandboxed (message dropped by email service; no real email was delivered).
users.emailNotConfigured: Account for {{name}} was created, but the invitation email was not sent because the email service is not configured (BREVO_API_KEY missing).
users.emailSendFailed: Account for {{name}} was created, but sending the invitation email failed. You can resend the invitation later.
users.emailNotSent: Account for {{name}} was created, but the invitation email was not sent.
users.empty: No users match these filters yet.
users.resendSandboxed: Invitation resent. In development mode, email delivery was sandboxed (message dropped by email service).
users.unauthorizedAction: Only PLACA Directors and Officers can create partner staff accounts.
users.confirmRoleChangeElevated: Assign elevated role {{newRole}} to {{name}}? This will grant administrative access to the platform.
users.cannotChangeSelf: You cannot change your own role.
users.elevatedRoleWarning: This role grants elevated administrative access across the platform.
users.roleUnchanged: Select a different role to change.

errors.ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only a PLACA director or system admin can change a user's role.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You cannot change your own role. Ask another director or system admin.
errors.USER_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have permission to manage this user.
errors.LGA_REQUIRED: Choose the LGA for this officer.
errors.ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot perform this action with your current role.
errors.ORGANIZATION_NOT_APPROVED: Approve the organization before creating partner staff accounts for it.
errors.ORGANIZATION_OUTSIDE_LGA: You can only create accounts for organizations in your own LGA.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email/phone or password is not correct.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked for a short time after too many wrong passwords.
errors.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: This account is not active. Contact your LACA officer or PLACA.
errors.TOTP_REQUIRED: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.INVALID_TOTP_CODE: That code did not work. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Choose a new password before using the platform.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.SESSION_REUSED: For your safety, please sign in again.
errors.REFRESH_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.REFRESH_INVALID: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.INVITATION_INVALID: This invitation link has expired or has already been used.
errors.RESET_INVALID: This reset link has expired or has already been used.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details need checking. Read the messages under each field.
errors.CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT: Your current password is not correct.
errors.SAME_PASSWORD: Choose a password you have not used before.
errors.NETWORK: No connection. Your work is still on this device. Try again when signal returns.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The assistant is not set up yet. Ask a PLACA administrator to add the Gemini API key.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The assistant took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.AI_BLOCKED: The assistant could not answer that request. Try asking in a different way.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.intro: The page you asked for does not exist.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.intro: Ask general questions about HIV and AIDS, public health, reporting practice or how to use PLACA. Answers are available in English and Hausa.
assistant.disclaimer: This assistant uses Gemini AI. It can make mistakes and its answers are not guaranteed, official or medical advice. It cannot see your account or any private PLACA records. Do not type names, phone numbers, addresses, HIV status or other personal information. Check important information with PLACA or a qualified health worker.
assistant.privacyBody: Only the messages in this conversation are sent to Gemini. Your name, email, role, organization, LGA and PLACA records are not sent.
assistant.empty: Start with a question. You can continue the same chat with follow-up questions.
assistant.generatedNotice: AI-generated. Check important details before acting on them.
assistant.failed: The assistant could not answer. Please try again.
assistant.loadFailed: Could not load your saved chats.
assistant.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
assistant.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. You can still type.
assistant.voiceHint: Voice uses your browser microphone. Allow microphone access when asked.
assistant.voiceError: Voice input stopped. You can try again or type your question.
assistant.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser or type your question.
assistant.languageNote: Reply language follows your selected language.
assistant.widgetDisclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Answers are not official or medical advice. Do not share personal information.
assistant.widgetPublicNote: You are not signed in. This chat is not saved and will clear when you leave or refresh. Sign in to keep your conversation.
assistant.widgetAccountNote: This chat is saved to your account. Open the full assistant page to see your recent chats.
